overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by mid-50s ERC/BI percentiles even as cool, mostly cloudy weather limits spread potential.**
- Danger is forecast to ease to Low by Saturday as ERC and BI percentiles drop from the low-50s into the upper-30s/30s through the weekend.
- Winds are light out of the NE at 11 mph today, but Friday brings gusty west winds up to 45 mph with a slight chance of snow showers and little accumulation expected.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area.
Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted in the Gunnison Field Office, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect. No county-level burn restrictions are currently active across the area's counties.
- Wildfire activity across Colorado remains quiet with no active large fires burning statewide, as recent mountain precipitation and light winds keep fire danger low. The only uncontained large fire nationally is in Wyoming, far from this area.
